title: Controlled Authorization Permission Review Gate
summary: Reviews permission-candidate language after preflight eligibility while keeping permission, authorization, execution, storage writes, canonical writes, public release, and production disabled.

review_checks.rule: Starts only from a ready permission preflight whose next gate is controlled permission review.
May mark permission review readiness, but cannot grant permission, approve permission, or authorize execution.
Keeps preflight, instruction gate, review gate, authorization draft, founder decision, source answer, source record, and family locked.
Execution, storage, canonical writes, public release, production, accounts, secrets, and migrations remain blocked.
Moves only to a founder permission decision gate, never to execution.
Expires on preflight, instruction, review, draft, source, rights, reviewer, rollback, monitoring, packet, or code change.
